thread:
Anya: Quick idea — run a 'lightning demo' series tied to our CloudPartner marketplace listing. 15-min live demos + a short blog + gated benchmark PDF. priority: generate MQLs and validate integration storytelling.
Matt: love it. timeline? thinking 3-week sprint to get landing, demo recordings, and routing flows.
Sophia: Partner is in — they can provide 2 engineers for demo Q&A and a customer reference for the benchmark. Need dates to lock.
Anya: Target week of May 9 for the first demo (dates TBD). We'll do 3 sessions over 3 weeks, different vertical focus each week.
Devon: For inbound routing: can we push marketplace leads -> HubSpot form with utm_source=cloudpartner&utm_campaign=lightning-demo and auto-assign to partner queue?
Jen: I'll draft the launch post + blog outline. Want the benchmark narrative to highlight latency/cost improvements on our Dedicated SKU vs. vanilla infra — simple before/after charts.
Matt: Good. Keep the benchmark narrative customer-centric: 'how ACME cut inference cost by 32% while improving 95th pct latency.' No heavy internals.
Sophia: Partner will send a short case snippet and consent for co-branded quote. Also can co-host the webinar.
Anya: Routing config proposal (Devon can implement):
```
if lead.source == 'cloud_marketplace' and utm_campaign == 'lightning-demo':
  lead.owner = 'partner-queue'
  lead.tag += ['marketplace:cloudpartner','campaign:lightning-demo']
  crm.stage = 'MQL'
```
Devon: I can implement. Will add a fallback: if partner-queue size > 15, round-robin to SDR-team. Also add a quick task to validate HubSpot mapping.
Jen: Draft of post headline options: 1) "Fast demos: See Redwood + CloudPartner in 15 minutes" 2) "How ACME sped inference & cut cost — join our lightning demo" Which do we prefer?
Matt: #2 hits benchmarking + social proof. Use that as the lead.
Anya: Action items: Jen — draft blog + landing; Devon — routing & hubspot mapping; Matt — social creative + ad copy; Sophia — secure partner quote + engineer schedule. I'll own webinar logistics and demo runbook.
Sophia: Confirmed — partner quote coming by EOD Friday.
Devon: HubSpot mapping PR opened: https://hub.company/PR-4732  I'll add automated tests for routing.
launch-bot: Reminder set: schedule post for 2026-05-08 10:00 UTC and webinar 2026-05-12 16:00 UTC.
Anya: Great — sync tomorrow 11am to review drafts and go/no-go. :thumbsup:
